post.caption: Hidden Valley's ranch became a diamond. On National Ranch Day in 2022, Hidden Valley revealed a diamond that a diamond maker grew in a lab from ranch seasoning. The process took five months and 400 tons of pressure. The result is a two carat round brilliant in a 14 karat white gold band, engraved inside with HVR LVR. It started at 310 dollars on eBay and sold for 12,550 dollars. All of it went to Feeding America, where every dollar provides at least 10 meals.
